metadata.title: Living Remotely | Trekking Up The Mountains To Home
metadata.description:
My second dose of COVID vaccine is already due and I am walking up to the nearby mountain where I get network to book my vaccination slot. 

In my previous video I showed you my walk down the hill to get my first dose of the vaccine. In this video, I am going to should you the dreaded climb back home after recieving my second dose of the vaccine. 

In this video, I also share a bit of history of my people. 

Music credits:
www.bensound.com

Thank you for watching. 
Lets connect!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/EatYourKappa/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/eatyourkappa/
Email: eatyourkappa@gmail.com
Twitter: https://twitter.com/eat_your_kappa
